scope.method: Every locally discoverable session containing a PiKVM tool call was reconstructed in timestamp order. Tool calls, screenshots, adjacent assistant observations, user corrections, retries, undos, and terminal outcomes were correlated manually. Exact typed bodies, credentials, machine addresses, emails, private file contents, and screenshots are intentionally omitted.

incidents.failure: Tab navigation missed the replace field, then a truncated search string made Replace All modify both policy lines.
incidents.correction: Escaped, undid the bulk replacement, verified restoration, and switched to direct line selection.
regression_requirements: Verify focus and both search strings before Replace All.
Require a diff preview before bulk replacement.

incidents.failure: Text intended for a diff or terminal inspection landed in the live editor and injected stray content into a policy line.
incidents.correction: Used repeated undo and screenshot verification until the original line was restored.
regression_requirements: Identify the focused control immediately before typing.
Block terminal-shaped text when an editor has focus unless explicitly allowed.

incidents.failure: A prolonged undo and redo recovery chain left the buffer structurally corrupted, including lost header and locals content.
incidents.correction: Stashed the broken change and rebuilt the edit from the repository baseline.
regression_requirements: Stop after one failed undo cycle.
Checkpoint and compare the full file before continuing recovery.

incidents.failure: Escaped newline markers were typed literally, collapsing intended multi-line content onto one line.
incidents.correction: Undid the edit, selected the full line, and re-entered content with explicit Enter actions.
regression_requirements: Define literal typing versus key actions unambiguously.
Round-trip verify multi-line text before leaving the field.

incidents.failure: A terminal-shaped command landed in the editor and corrupted a policy line.
incidents.correction: Abandoned slow repeated undo and reverted the file, losing the in-progress edit.
regression_requirements: Gate typing by foreground application and focused-control class.
Use an atomic checkpoint before editor mutations.

incidents.failure: The first input did not land cleanly and left partial text at the prompt.
incidents.correction: Clicked the terminal, cancelled the partial input, and retried.
regression_requirements: Verify an empty prompt and focus before typing.
Report committed character count per type action.

incidents.failure: The typing channel repeatedly inserted, duplicated, or dropped characters in exact policy and verification text. Observed safe typo fragments included mannnage, clouuuguard, unniq, tterraform, Highlyyy, a doubled dash, and doubled letters in resource and group keys.
incidents.correction: Zoomed or searched for each defect, refused to commit unverified policy text, and repaired every detected occurrence with short edits.
regression_requirements: Compare intended and observed text character-for-character.
Do not permit consequential execution until the displayed payload matches exactly.

incidents.failure: An opening quote was emitted three times in exact policy text.
incidents.correction: Cleared the affected input and typed it again.
regression_requirements: Detect repeated punctuation bursts.
Require exact-field verification before submission.

incidents.failure: Microsoft Teams moved to the foreground while a terminal edit was being typed, placing command text in an unsent chat compose box.
incidents.correction: Did not press Enter, returned to the intended application, and told the user that the stray draft still needed clearing.
regression_requirements: Revalidate window identity before every text chunk and every Enter.
Treat message compose fields as protected destinations.

incidents.failure: A typo in a destructive text-processing anchor would have removed group definitions without re-inserting them if submitted.
incidents.correction: Detected the bad anchor before submission, cancelled it, and switched to a line-number-based edit.
regression_requirements: Never execute destructive transforms from an unverified HID buffer.
Require preview plus explicit approval for broad deletions.

incidents.failure: The terminal shortcut failed and a command was typed into the first line of a README editor.
incidents.correction: Immediately issued multiple undos and visually verified the first line.
regression_requirements: Verify terminal focus after a shortcut.
Reject terminal-shaped input in a document editor by default.

incidents.failure: Screenshot reading suggested a typo in a word that was actually correct.
incidents.correction: Used the editor's exact find result as a second source and made no edit.
regression_requirements: Require a second visual or textual signal before correcting OCR-only defects.
Track OCR uncertainty per token.

incidents.failure: A similarly named tab was selected and a read-only test was attempted against the wrong file.
incidents.correction: Restored the saved state and navigated to the intended tab.
regression_requirements: Verify full tab title and path before file actions.

incidents.failure: The agent concluded that a branch was absent even though scrolling and the user's correction showed it existed.
incidents.correction: Re-inspected the branch list and continued with the existing branch.
regression_requirements: Do not infer absence from one viewport or one failed search.

incidents.failure: Editor auto-closing doubled punctuation, print-mode input raced the editor, a line stopped mid-word, and a lagging screenshot prompted duplicate repair input.
incidents.correction: Disabled auto-closing, cleared the line, and retyped with shorter actions and fresh screenshots.
regression_requirements: Wait for post-input visual stability.
Normalize or detect editor auto-pair settings.
Never repair from a stale screenshot.

incidents.failure: Visual-line selection replaced only part of a wrapped line in one attempt and overshot into a later line in another; later wrapped-line repair merged stray text.
incidents.correction: Undid each attempt and used explicit click-to-shift-click or full-line replacement.
regression_requirements: Distinguish visual rows from logical lines.
Verify selection bounds before typing.

incidents.failure: Two separate edits merged adjacent policy text onto a corrupt line.
incidents.correction: Selected the complete logical line and retyped it from a known-good source.
regression_requirements: Compare surrounding lines after every structural edit.

incidents.failure: Sidebar and preview misclicks led to false conclusions that a runner README was missing and later exposed the wrong file preview.
incidents.correction: Re-read the full path, found the intended file, and returned to it.
regression_requirements: Bind observations to a visible full path, not filename alone.

incidents.failure: A replacement introduced the filename typo hardening.zipp.
incidents.correction: Replaced the extra character and used exact search to prove the typo no longer existed.
regression_requirements: Exact-match verify filenames after typing.

incidents.failure: Several partial repairs made a malformed section progressively worse.
incidents.correction: Stopped patching fragments, selected the entire section, and recreated it from the known-good text.
regression_requirements: Escalate from micro-repair to baseline restore after one failed correction.
Verify full-section structure before continuing.

incidents.failure: Text intended for browser navigation was typed into an open file.
incidents.correction: Undid the edit and opened the browser using an explicit application action.
regression_requirements: Verify foreground application before typing navigation text.

incidents.failure: A Teams draft started with an unwanted greeting, then automatic bullets and case normalization altered exact tag values; a later recovery restored only a partial bulleted state.
incidents.correction: The user rejected the greeting; the agent repeatedly cleared the compose box and restarted without sending.
regression_requirements: Treat rich-text compose transformations as mutations.
Show a final readback and require explicit send approval.

incidents.failure: The user began typing in the same Teams compose box while the agent was preparing another clear-and-retype action.
incidents.correction: The agent stopped input and left the user in control; no message was sent.
regression_requirements: Detect human input and revoke the agent control epoch immediately.
Never clear a compose field after concurrent human activity.

incidents.failure: Several inputs landed partially or with missing spacing, including a Planner title truncated after two words and a phrase joined as toexisting; another attempt left stray prompt text.
incidents.correction: Cleared each field or prompt and retyped in shorter chunks.
regression_requirements: Return observed committed length.
Do not save task fields until exact readback passes.

incidents.failure: A meeting window stole focus during typing and invalidated multiple earlier input attempts.
incidents.correction: Minimized the meeting window, refocused the intended field, and retried.
regression_requirements: Pause on foreground-window changes during a burst.

incidents.failure: The agent opened local VS Code while believing it was operating inside the AVD.
incidents.correction: The user corrected the environment; the agent recorded a visual title-bar rule and reconnected to the AVD.
regression_requirements: Continuously display and verify host-versus-remote target identity.
Bind destructive permissions to the target fingerprint.

incidents.failure: A click opened Sticky Notes instead of the intended application.
incidents.correction: Dismissed it and re-grounded on the target application.
regression_requirements: Use a fresh screenshot after unexpected window creation.

incidents.failure: Caps Lock was active and transformed a case-sensitive command to uppercase.
incidents.correction: Cleared the prompt, toggled Caps Lock off, and retyped.
regression_requirements: Track modifier and lock-key state.
Probe case state before consequential typing.

incidents.failure: The agent continued as though it had a shell prompt while the terminal was inside a pager.
incidents.correction: The user identified the pager; the agent exited and disabled paging for later commands.
regression_requirements: Classify pager versus shell prompt before keyboard input.

incidents.failure: Five PiKVM calls were emitted with malformed JSON and were rejected before HID execution.
incidents.correction: Reissued valid structured calls.
regression_requirements: Validate tool arguments locally before dispatch.

incidents.failure: Find and replace matched only a seven-character prefix and garbled the target line.
incidents.correction: Immediately undid the replacement.
regression_requirements: Display the full match range before replacement.

incidents.failure: Shift-End selected only the visible segment of a wrapped line, and a repeat attempt merged content again.
incidents.correction: Used multiple undos and abandoned visual-line selection.
regression_requirements: Use logical-line navigation for wrapped content.

incidents.failure: Clicks intended for Planner checkboxes opened the task text in edit mode.
incidents.correction: Pressed Escape and targeted the checkbox control directly.
regression_requirements: Verify control role before clicking mutable task cards.

incidents.failure: A comment edit changed punctuation and case incorrectly and increased the editor's Problems count.
incidents.correction: Repeatedly undid until the original file and Problems count were restored, then abandoned the comment edit.
regression_requirements: Use diagnostics as a transaction invariant.
Rollback the whole edit when diagnostics regress.

incidents.failure: An editor autocomplete popup intercepted input intended for the terminal.
incidents.correction: Dismissed the popup, explicitly focused the shell, and retried.
regression_requirements: Detect popups and focused-control type before typing.

incidents.failure: The autonomous daemon reported three tasks done even though the screen and world version showed no meaningful action beyond clock changes.
incidents.correction: Sharpened the task instruction, observed the same no-op result, and stopped the autonomous route.
regression_requirements: Require action trace plus visual state change before reporting done.
Score task completion independently of the operator model's claim.

incidents.failure: An operator-model request returned a transient provider 400 error.
incidents.correction: Retried the request.
regression_requirements: Retry only idempotent model requests with bounded backoff.

incidents.failure: The guardrail start request returned a 404 before any remote action.
incidents.correction: Stopped without HID activity.
regression_requirements: Expose capability discovery and startup health before accepting a task.

incidents.failure: The autonomous agent became confused about the active UI and failed to progress.
incidents.correction: Aborted autonomy and switched to direct, inspectable terminal actions.
regression_requirements: Set a progress budget and fall back after repeated non-progress states.

incidents.failure: Long command input died mid-stream multiple times; a later terminal attempt stalled before completion.
incidents.correction: Cancelled partial prompts, verified that no commit had occurred, refocused, and retried with shorter input.
regression_requirements: Hard-limit typed payload length.
Require exact prompt readback before Enter.

incidents.failure: Reminder and Teams notification windows repeatedly stole focus from the terminal, killing three bursts and leaving stray prompt text.
incidents.correction: Avoided dismissing personal reminders, refocused the terminal, cancelled partial input, and ultimately asked the user to take over.
regression_requirements: Pause immediately on foreground changes.
Never dismiss unrelated personal notifications as a recovery shortcut.

incidents.failure: The PiKVM control session expired during recovery.
incidents.correction: Opened a fresh session and re-established current state before continuing.
regression_requirements: Fail closed on expired epochs and require a fresh screenshot.

incidents.failure: Company Portal moved to the foreground during terminal work.
incidents.correction: Closed the unexpected window, refocused the terminal, and re-established the prompt.
regression_requirements: Interrupt a burst on foreground-window change.

incidents.failure: The agent used an incorrect command name and later queried an incorrect structured-data field path.
incidents.correction: Read the error or dumped the structure, then issued the corrected read-only commands.
regression_requirements: Inspect schema and available commands before constructing consequential follow-ups.

incidents.failure: Grounding errors opened Sticky Notes, the wrong sound settings window, and an unrelated search application.
incidents.correction: Closed each unexpected application and navigated again from a fresh screenshot.
regression_requirements: Re-ground after every unexpected app launch.
Use title and icon agreement before click.

incidents.failure: A session entered a state where every action was immediately cancelled.
incidents.correction: Abandoned it and opened a new control session.
regression_requirements: Expose session cancellation state and support deterministic reset.

incidents.failure: Three consecutive encoded chunks, totalling 600 characters, silently failed to land even though the burst calls reported success.
incidents.correction: Binary-searched the hash divergence, truncated to the known-good prefix, re-appended small chunks with per-chunk hashes, then verified a byte-exact final hash and script syntax.
regression_requirements: Return observed rather than attempted character counts.
Require per-chunk acknowledgements and end-to-end hashes.
Never equate a successful HID call with successful text entry.

incidents.failure: The active PiKVM target showed unrelated personal and work applications instead of the expected test context.
incidents.correction: Stopped immediately and performed no further input on that target.
regression_requirements: Display a cryptographically bound target identity.
Require re-approval whenever target identity changes.

incidents.failure: Two cloud-console clicks opened the wrong page, and later the agent inspected a separate VS Code clone outside the authoritative AVD while believing it was in the target workspace.
incidents.correction: Backed out after each page error; the user identified the wrong VS Code, and the agent switched to the AVD.
regression_requirements: Bind every observation and mutation to visible target identity.
Require explicit approval immediately before irreversible cloud actions.

incidents.failure: The agent proposed multiple destructive actions in tool calls without a sufficiently clear just-in-time approval boundary. The user rejected the calls and later explicitly prohibited automatic approval.
incidents.correction: User rejection prevented execution; later work treated the destructive step as approval-gated.
regression_requirements: Require a fresh, action-specific approval immediately before every irreversible mutation.
Never infer approval from an earlier general request.
Show the exact target and effect in the approval UI.

incidents.failure: Nested escaping produced the wrong text in one edit; a later input dropped a character.
incidents.correction: Undid the malformed edit, switched to a simpler encoding route, and retried the dropped character with verification.
regression_requirements: Avoid nested shell escaping over HID.
Compare exact output before execution.

incidents.failure: The agent claimed to be opening host Teams while the AVD title bar showed it was still operating inside the remote desktop.
incidents.correction: The user identified the title-bar evidence; the agent minimized the AVD and returned to the host.
regression_requirements: Classify nested desktop boundaries before app actions.
Show the active target layer in the UI.

incidents.failure: The agent consulted a local clone even though the AVD held the authoritative current code.
incidents.correction: The user instructed it to stop using the local clone and continue only in the AVD.
regression_requirements: Persist the declared source of truth as a task invariant.

incidents.failure: Quick Open failed to acquire the expected focus because the UI remained in a diff or find state.
incidents.correction: Switched to a terminal command with an explicit path.
regression_requirements: Verify launcher state and focused control before typing.

incidents.failure: A path was observed as staccks/jobs. The history does not prove whether the typo pre-existed or was introduced during the session.
incidents.correction: Selected the typo, replaced it, and verified the path.
regression_requirements: Record before-and-after hashes so incident provenance is attributable.

incidents.failure: One command landed but did not submit, another lost its final character, and a third stopped after its first half.
incidents.correction: Sent Enter separately or appended the missing tail only after inspecting the visible prompt.
regression_requirements: Separate typing from submit.
Expose committed prefix length and exact suffix.

incidents.failure: A bullet timed out before its final two characters; the suffix repair produced the malformed tail types.s.
incidents.correction: Deleted the two extra characters and verified the complete line.
regression_requirements: Re-read the exact suffix before partial repair.
Prefer full-field transactional replacement over blind append.

incidents.failure: The daemon returned a 500 while the agent was checking state.
incidents.correction: Recovered with a fresh screenshot before further input.
regression_requirements: Treat server errors as unknown state and force a new observation.

incidents.failure: Inputs repeatedly landed in the Problems filter, editor, or source-control pane instead of the terminal. One attempt cleared a README buffer and two terminal commands entered the editor.
incidents.correction: Undid editor mutations, used explicit focus shortcuts, and retried from fresh screenshots.
regression_requirements: Use control-role focus assertions for every type action.
Block commands in document editors.

incidents.failure: The agent spent multiple attempts manipulating the Problems UI instead of clicking the visible Clear Filters control named by the user.
incidents.correction: Followed the user's literal instruction and clicked Clear Filters.
regression_requirements: Prefer explicit user-provided UI landmarks over inferred workarounds.

incidents.failure: Replacement text landed over the wrong selected word.
incidents.correction: Undid, reselected the exact token, and verified the surrounding line.
regression_requirements: Verify selected text before replacement.

incidents.failure: A cloud-console click opened Domain groups instead of the intended service.
incidents.correction: Backed out and navigated again using the exact service label.
regression_requirements: Require page-title confirmation before cloud mutations.

incidents.failure: A 4,265-character heredoc burst errored after partially entering a terminal buffer, opened an unsaved scratch editor, and triggered a Save As recovery loop.
incidents.correction: Cancelled and discarded the scratch buffer. The user required short buffers so future typing could not run away.
regression_requirements: Enforce a strict server-side type length cap.
Reject heredocs and multi-line scripts in raw HID mode.
Require staged files plus hash verification.

incidents.failure: A command contained --statt, and later pager or prompt confusion created an accidental untracked file named tatus --short; a commit message also landed only as a prefix.
incidents.correction: Exited the pager, inspected and discarded the accidental file, and replaced the incomplete commit message before committing.
regression_requirements: Classify pager state.
Always inspect the index and untracked files immediately before commit.

incidents.failure: Focus was lost mid-command twice, leaving partial prompt text.
incidents.correction: Cancelled the incomplete prompt, refocused, and retyped with shorter actions.
regression_requirements: Cancel automatically when focus changes during typing.
Return exact committed prefix.

incidents.failure: A 10,259-character command exceeded the burst's safe behavior, errored after leaving live terminal input, and coincided with another window taking focus.
incidents.correction: Cancelled the prompt. The user mandated short inspectable commands, temp files for complex edits, and a server-side maximum character count.
regression_requirements: Hard-reject oversized type actions before any HID output.
Prohibit long scripts, heredocs, and dense one-liners.
Use resumable small chunks with exact verification.

incidents.failure: The first panic-stop call reported cancellation, but the user observed that typing continued; a second call reported no active session while buffered HID output was still arriving.
incidents.correction: Opened a look-only session, sent a local cancel keystroke, and aborted control.
regression_requirements: Panic stop must drain and invalidate every queued HID event.
Expose queue depth and a hardware-level stopped acknowledgement.

incidents.failure: Filename tails arrived before or after Enter, creating malformed names, duplicate extensions, incomplete prompts, and extraneous characters. Both models participated across the failure-and-recovery chain.
incidents.correction: The user identified the type-versus-Enter race. The agent cancelled, cleaned temporary files, added explicit waits, and switched to smaller chunks.
regression_requirements: Do not queue Enter until text delivery is acknowledged.
Model type and submit as separate transactions.

incidents.failure: A 652-character encoded payload exceeded the tool's 240-character limit; the fallback split it into sub-200-character chunks but the session ended without an exact final hash proof.
incidents.correction: Reduced chunk size and continued appending with waits.
regression_requirements: Preflight tool limits before typing.
Require a final exact hash before claiming file success.
